conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Lab Glassware
style.description: A bright clean laboratory bench in soft daylight: white worktop, pale tiled wall, clear glassware (beakers, conical flasks, measuring cylinders, test tubes in a rack, a burette on a stand, a funnel) holding saturated coloured liquids with a visible meniscus, printed graduations, bubbles and small enamel labels. Liquids are quantities: levels rise and fall to exact graduations from each vessel's volume curve, a vessel tilts and pours a parabolic stream with volume conserved into a differently shaped vessel, colours swirl and settle to a dye blend, a burette drips until the planned drop flips the colour, bubbles fizz and a foam head rises, and layers stack by density.

gradu.font: "Avenir Next Condensed", "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

readout.font: "Avenir Next Condensed", "Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

motion: Measure: a level rises from the floor of a vessel to an exact graduation (computed from the vessel's volume curve) and settles with a small damped wobble; a reading tag points at the meniscus.

Pour: the source lifts, pivots about its lip and tilts exactly as far as its remaining volume needs to reach the lip; a parabolic stream arcs out and the target rises by the same volume in its own shape.
Mix: the incoming colours swirl through the target in spiral arms and settle to a dye (Beer-Lambert) blend.
Threshold: a burette drips counted drops; each makes a brief bloom that fades until the planned drop spreads its colour through the whole vessel.
Fizz: bubbles stream up the wall and a foam head rises and settles; layered liquids stack by density.
Camera: eye level to read the scales, a little higher to see into the vessels, one slow move per beat, ending on a wide bench that fills the frame.

objects.procedural: white lab worktop with a rounded nosing and a pale square-tiled wall behind
retort stand: enamel base plate, steel rod, boss head, clamp arm and jaws
enamel-painted test-tube rack with six slots

notes.mechanism: liquids.js: levels from each vessel's volume-vs-height table; pours tilt the source exactly as far as its remaining volume needs to reach the lip (tiltForLip) and the beaker receives the same volume a fall-time later; mixDyes blends colours (Beer-Lambert); planDrops counts drops, drop 6 flips the colour; SCORE = scoreFromEvents(events(plan)).
notes.sample: All quantities on screen are SAMPLE DATA.
